design_gotchas.title: Non-Rail-to-Rail Upper Input and Output Headroom Ceiling
design_gotchas.detail: While inputs sense down to ground (V-), the upper common-mode limit is (V+) - 1.5 V at 25°C and (V+) - 2.0 V over 0°C to 70°C, and the output cannot swing above (V+) - 1.5 V at 5 V supply. On 3.3 V or 5 V rails, usable linear range is severely compressed compared to RRIO parts like TLV9002IDR.

design_gotchas.title: Identical SOIC-8 Pinout Trap vs LM393DR Open-Collector Comparator
design_gotchas.detail: LM358DR and LM393DR share the exact same 8-pin SOIC pinout (OUT1/IN1-/IN1+/V-/IN2+/IN2-/OUT2/V+), but LM358DR is a compensated push-pull op-amp while LM393DR is an uncompensated open-collector comparator. Swapping LM393DR into an LM358DR socket causes missing high-side drive without pull-up resistors and severe instability under negative feedback.

design_gotchas.title: Commercial 0°C to 70°C Rating and 500 V HBM ESD on Legacy LM358DR
design_gotchas.detail: Standard LM358DR is only specified for 0°C to 70°C, 30 V max supply, 7 mV max VOS, and ±500 V HBM ESD. Do not confuse it with the next-generation LM358BDR (-40°C to +85°C, 36 V, 3 mV max VOS, ±2000 V HBM) or LM2904B (-40°C to +125°C) covered in the same datasheet.

design_gotchas.title: Class-B Output Crossover Distortion and Weak Sink Current Near Ground
design_gotchas.detail: The bipolar Class-B output stage introduces noticeable crossover distortion in AC/audio signals and sinks only 12 µA min (30 µA typ) when VO = 200 mV. Add a pull-down load resistor to V- when sinking current close to ground or when minimizing crossover distortion.

typical_use_cases: Low-side current sensing and ground-referenced DC control loops on 12 V–24 V industrial rails
Cost-sensitive power supply voltage/current regulation and battery charger feedback
General-purpose active low-pass filtering and DC buffer stages below 10 kHz
Legacy 5 V to 30 V board maintenance and second-source industrial control modules
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments LM358DR is the industry-standard dual general-purpose bipolar operational amplifier in an 8-pin SOIC (D) package, rated for 3 V to 30 V single-supply operation (32 V abs max) over 0°C to 70°C. Its PNP differential input stage includes ground (V-) for low-side sensing, but upper common-mode and positive output headroom stop 1.5 V–2.0 V below V+. With 0.7 MHz GBWP, 0.3 V/µs slew rate, 350 µA/ch typical Iq, and 20 nA input bias current, it excels in low-cost 12 V–24 V DC loops but should not be swapped blindly with 5.5 V RRIO op-amps (LMV358IDR, TLV9002IDR) or the pin-identical LM393DR comparator.
